senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נגע)to strike, knock, v. נְגִינָה.
(cmp. Lat. pulso) to play on a musical instrument, in gen. to make music.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 63b:1">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>חנניה יְנַגֵּן בכנור</he> let Hananiah play on the harp (act as a Levite).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 113">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 872">Yalk. Ps. 872</cite> <he>והייתי מְנַגֶּנֶת לך</he> and I (Israel) was singing unto thee; a. fr.
